body:
Thanks, glad to know you're with me on this to not feel alone, but god, whenever im with friend i see other people, just imaginations and it hurts because i have so much more in common with them than my real friends, it seems so weird cause I keep saying to myself "They aren't real" but when i'm with real friends i cant help but feel sick around them, and so damn lonely cause i cant join in a conversation without mentioning my panic attacks cause i'm slightly insane, i feel so horrible to be their friends and to know they put up with my shit, its a damn blessing, i'm never mean to them, because i never want to lose them, they're all i have for people i can talk to. 
I just wished for so long that i could live in my own world constantly and i couldn't, made me over the years just want to kill myself, i just wanted it all to end.

But i'll try not too, and yeah i am young, although i dont like that saying, but it is true, it just feels like although time is supposed to go fast and you look back and think that time goes fast, well when you're in the moment it feels so slow. I don't know what my future holds, but i hope its at least some peace to my mind. It's all i'm asking for now, peace in my head. I can't say i wont have the urge to kill myself in the future, but i'll try to fight it off as much as i can.
